mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_code (group_code, code, code_name, sort_order) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT code_id AS codeId, group_code AS groupCode, code AS code, code_name AS codeName, sort_order AS sortOrder, use_yn AS useYn FROM erp_code WHERE group_code = #{groupCode} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
